description: This file defines a database migration class for updating the schema from version 16 to 17 in an Android app's local database using Room. It adds a new column 'SCROLL_Y' to the 'NOTES' table to store scroll positions.

classes.name: Migration_16_17
classes.description: A migration class for upgrading the database schema from version 16 to 17 by adding a 'SCROLL_Y' column to the 'NOTES' table.

methods.name: Migration_16_17
methods.description: Constructor initializing the migration from version 16 to 17.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the SQL command to alter the 'NOTES' table, adding the 'SCROLL_Y' column.

calls: db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE NOTES ADD COLUMN SCROLL_Y INTEGER DEFAULT 0")
